post.title: When the Job Goes, So Does the Coverage: ICESCR Article 12 and the Health Access Gap
key_claims: ICESCR Article 12 recognizes the right to the highest attainable standard of physical and mental health (treaty text)
CESCR GC 14 (2000) elaborates Article 12 through the AAAQ framework: availability, accessibility, acceptability, quality
Economic accessibility requires health services to be affordable regardless of employment classification
Approximately 160 million Americans receive health coverage through employer-sponsored insurance — AI displacement severs this link
Article 12(2)(b)+(c) address occupational health; U.S. gig/platform workers classified as independent contractors fall outside OSHA employee protections
Mental health effects of prior automation displacement waves are documented at population level — Article 12 covers mental health with equal weight
Algorithmic management systems in gig work introduce occupational stressors outside any current regulatory framework
